name: email-cards
description: Email Cards: your inbox, one card at a time

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:pages: VITE_STATIC_DEMO=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/email-cards/ npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
